descriptions.zh: 一条舰船漂浮在太空中，没有信号交互。更仔细的检查也许能弄清她的船员遭遇了些什么。
descriptions.en: A ship adrift in space, no signals going in or coming out. Inspecting it more closely might shed some light on what has happened to the crew.

descriptions.zh: 一支在沙漠星球上坠毁的古老舰队被发现了，她们的舰载AI仍然活跃。如果我们不去压制她，情况会急转直下。
descriptions.en: An ancient fleet has been found crashed on a desert planet, with a still-active shipboard AI. If we do not move to subdue it, things might take a turn for the worse.

descriptions.zh: 这颗星似乎能聚变产生铍，但这理应是不可能的。
descriptions.en: The star is appearing to be able to fuse beryllium, which shouldn't be possible.

descriptions.zh: 一个陶瓷茶壶围绕着恒星公转……这实在令人难以置信。搞清楚它是怎么形成的需要耗费很多时间。谁知道我们能否找到这个问题的答案，或者说甚至这个问题根本就没有答案？
descriptions.en: A ceramic pot is orbiting a sun... this is beyond improbable. Figuring out what it does there will take quite some time. Who knows what the answer will be, or if there even is one?

descriptions.zh: 一个古老的挖掘机正在向巨大的小行星深处挖掘。如果我们能够在碎石压坏它之前停下它，我们也许可以学到一些建设方面有用的东西。
descriptions.en: An ancient excavator is digging deep into a giant asteroid. If we can stop it before it gets crushed by debris we might be able to learn something worthwhile about the construction.

descriptions.zh: 一座被遗弃的传感器阵列似乎处于工作状态。如果我们能修复它并弄清楚它是如何工作的，我们也许能获得更多周边星系的详细信息。
descriptions.en: An abandoned sensor dish seems to be in working condition. If we perform some repairs and figure out how it functions we might be able to gain more insight into neighboring systems.

descriptions.zh: 一艘外星飞船在小行星带中漂泊。它并没有回应呼叫。我们应该调查到底发生了什么。
descriptions.en: An alien ship is drifting inside an asteroid belt. It will not respond to hails. We should investigate and see what is going on.

descriptions.zh: 一个宏伟的哺乳动物种群漫步在水草丰茂的旷野。他们似乎对我们的靠近有点不安。近距离的研究能带给我们更多的信息。
descriptions.en: A majestic race of mammals roam fields of water grass. They seem skittish and have insight into our approaches. Studying them up close could give us more information.

descriptions.zh: 在一颗遥远的星球上发现一座了塞满机器人的工厂。如果我们重新激活他们，可能会揭示他们家园的秘密。
descriptions.en: A facility filled with robots has been found on a distant planet. If we reactivate them, they might reveal the secrets of their home.

descriptions.zh: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]
descriptions.en: [Root.Owner.GetMonsterOnShipDesc]

descriptions.zh: 一棵树孤零零地在太空的虚无中漂流，它的汁液吸引了太空中的各种凶猛生物。我们应该调查它的作用。
descriptions.en: A tree drifts defiantly through the emptiness of space. Its sap seems to attract monstrous spaceborne organics. We should investigate to figure out its purpose.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一摞文件，这似乎对一个已经消亡的社群很重要。翻译它们定能为我们提供更深入了解其历史与文化的机会。
descriptions.en: We have uncovered a stash of documents that seem to have been important to the now dead society. Translating them will surely provide us with a more in-depth look into its history and culture.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一个外星人探险家携带的一些文本。如果我们能够翻译它们，我们也许能了解更多有关它曾经主人的信息。
descriptions.en: We've found some texts that were carried by an alien expedition. If we translate them we might uncover more information and learn about the previous owners.

descriptions.zh: 我们在一个貌似星际贸易站的废墟中发现了一些文本。如果我们能够翻译这些文件，我们可以更多地了解那些建立它的人。
descriptions.en: We've found some texts among the ruins of a possible interstellar trading hub. If we translate these documents we could learn more about the ones who founded it.

descriptions.zh: 我们在一个废弃已久的战场遗迹上发现了一群战士的遗骸，以及他们所携带的必定对他们很重要的文件。如果我们翻译这些文件，我们可以了解的更多关于这个种族以及他们所进行的战争。
descriptions.en: We found remains of a warrior people on a long abandoned battlefield, and they were carrying texts that must have been important to them. If we translate these documents we could learn more about this people and the wars they fought.

descriptions.zh: 我们在山体底下找到了一个可能包含宝贵信息或者装置的建筑物。它的周围有危险的野生动物，为了得到它我们需要制服这些野兽。
descriptions.en: We found a structure beneath a mountain which could contain valuable information or gear. It is surrounded by dangerous wildlife and we need to subdue these beasts in order to get to it.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现的避难所中存放着一个容器。如果我们想知道里面有什么，我们需要找到撬开它的最佳方法。
descriptions.en: The underground vault we found held only a container of sorts. We need to figure out how to best pry it open if we want to find out what is inside.

descriptions.zh: 一艘外星人的巡洋舰躺在[Root.GetName]的海底。打捞她也许能得到宝贵的技术或资源。
descriptions.en: An alien battlecruiser lies beneath the waves of [Root.GetName]. Salvaging it could yield valuable technology or resources.

descriptions.zh: 尝试移除我们在[Root.GetName]上的致幻气体。
descriptions.en: Attempt to remove the hallucinogen from [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere.

descriptions.zh: 通过研究在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们有望了解它们，甚至与它们进行交流。
descriptions.en: By studying the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we can hopefully learn to understand them and possibly even communicate.

descriptions.zh: 通过捕获在[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们将会研究出如何利用它们！
descriptions.en: By harvesting the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we should soon work out how best to exploit them!

descriptions.zh: 通过谨慎地监视[Root.GetName]上的泰坦巨兽，我们希望尽可能与它们和平共处。
descriptions.en: By carefully monitoring the Titanic Life of [Root.GetName], we hope to be able to coexist peacefully with them.

descriptions.zh: 数个奇怪的磁场干扰已经影响了[Root.GetName]上的生活。直到不久之前，磁场干扰的起因仍是个谜，但现在我们已经积累了足够的数据，应该可以揭露真相了。
descriptions.en: Several strange magnetic disturbances have unsettled life on [Root.GetName]. Until recently their cause was a complete mystery, but with the data gathered from repeated events it should now be possible to uncover the truth behind them.

descriptions.zh: 派遣一艘舰船去外星人的母星，我们将在它们身上收集那些我们认为它们从我们身上搜集了的数据。
descriptions.en: Sending a ship to the alien homeworld, we will be able to gather the same data on them that we suspect them to have on us.

descriptions.zh: 我们必须找出那个似乎对我们有放松作用的神秘乐器的原始物质。
descriptions.en: We must find the source material of the mysterious instrument that appears to have a relaxing effect on us.

descriptions.zh: [missing_pops_planet.GetName]的执法部门为了顺利地调查最近的一起神秘的人口失踪事件，需要军队的配合来平息骚乱。
descriptions.en: Local law-enforcement on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] need the support of a military strike force to stifle unrest as they investigate a recent wave of mysterious disappearances.

descriptions.zh: 最近一种名叫寿无限的抗衰老霜疯狂地在全帝国境内传播。这种抗衰老霜已经被证实具有刺激细胞再生的功能。如果我们能确定其中起作用的成分，或许能延长其有效时间。
descriptions.en: The new anti-aging cream Ageless is spreading like a wild-fire throughout the empire, and has shown promise of actually stimulating cell-regeneration. If we could identify the active agent we might be able to use it to produce a more lasting effect.

titles.en: In Pursuit of a Wrinkle-Free Existence

descriptions.zh: 我们必须找到这种抗衰老霜的来源。
descriptions.en: We must find the origin of this cream.

descriptions.zh: 对[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]进行详细勘察，试图弄清它的来源。
descriptions.en: Conduct a detailed survey of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] and attempt to figure out where it came from.

descriptions.zh: 调查位面传送门通向何方。
descriptions.en: Investigate where the Dimensional Portal leads to.

descriptions.zh: 通过科学研究一定可以找到关闭这个传送门的方法！
descriptions.en: There has to be a way to close this portal, and science will find it!

descriptions.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用正能量来反制！
descriptions.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with positive energy!

descriptions.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用灵能来反制！
descriptions.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with Psionic energy!

descriptions.zh: 往里丢足够多的石头，或许可以把它堵住？
descriptions.en: Perhaps dumping enough rock into the portal will block it up?

descriptions.zh: 当经历过[Root.GetName]上的大破坏之后，我们不禁在想到底谁才是或者说巨尸乐队到底是怎么样的存在？
descriptions.en: After the incredible destruction on [Root.GetName] we are left wondering: Who or what are MegaCorpse?

descriptions.zh: 无论是什么样的力量在将暗物质带往我们的传送门，将其更多的吸引过来应该可以增加暗物质的产出。
descriptions.en: Whatever the strange force bringing Dark Matter to our portal is, attracting a higher level of it should result in increased production.

descriptions.zh: 通过将他们的神经扫描结果上传到到机器身体上，我们可以给这一灭绝的远古外星物种重获新生的机会。
descriptions.en: We could give an extinct species of ancient aliens a second chance at life by uploading their neural scans to robotic bodies.

descriptions.zh: 一个针对最近在§Y远古克隆仓§!的量子生物编码中发现的密码的破译计划。这是个让我们离重获繁育能力更近一步的努力。
descriptions.en: A project to work out the cipher recently discovered within the quantum bio-code of the §YAncient Clone Vats§!. An effort to bring us closer to finally reclaiming our fertility.

descriptions.zh: 不管在这个古代生物的意识世界里是什么情况，至少我们的现实宇宙还是好好地存在着。通过动用某些禁术和最新科技，我们的死灵法师相信他们能够为这个死去的生物再构造一个幻境世界。
descriptions.en: Despite what the ancient being may have thought, the universe continues to exist outside of its dead husk. Using a combination of forbidden techniques and new science, our necromancers believe they can put the lie to the departed creature's solipsism.

descriptions.zh: 通过对尼玛的初步研究，并结合我们的动物学知识，现在可以鼓励这一温顺驯服的物种在它们栖息地的承载范围内欣欣向荣地发展。
descriptions.en: By first studying the Nemmas and then applying our zoological expertise, we can encourage docile and obedient specimens to flourish within the carrying capacity of their habitat.

descriptions.zh: 先进的药物和义体植入体可以将尼玛变得更加温顺和易于操控。这一以来它们就可以成为负载能力强大的巨兽。
descriptions.en: Advanced drugs and cybernetic implants will render the Nemmas more docile and impressionable. In time they shall become gigantic beasts of burden.

descriptions.zh: 在小心地研究了尼玛的生物学构成后，我们的[Root.owner.GetScientistPlural]可以有效地才这些巨星爬行动物的外壳中收获有用的矿物。
descriptions.en: After carefully studying the Nemmas' biology, our [Root.owner.GetScientistPlural] can successfully harvest useful minerals from the shells of these gigantic reptiles.

descriptions.zh: 我们将不择手段从这个星球上将尼玛的威胁清除干净。
descriptions.en: We will expunge the Nemma menace from this planet by any means necessary.

descriptions.zh: 应该让尼玛处于在我们最好的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]的保护之下，然后试图寻找解决方案。
descriptions.en: We shall put the fate of the Nemma in the care of our best [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and see what solutions can be found.

descriptions.zh: [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上的纳米虫群既是一种科学奇迹，又是一个危险。溯其起源及它们与这颗星球独特生态系统的联系对我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]来说是一个使其兴奋的挑战，当然也可潜在地促进我们对机械智能的理解。
descriptions.en: The nanite swarm on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName] is both a technological marvel and a danger. Charting the origin of the nanites as well as their relation to the planet's unique ecology provides an exciting challenge for our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] while also potentially advancing our understanding of machine intelligence.

descriptions.zh: 下令对虫群进行轨道轰炸。如果有任何值得发现的秘密，我们可以从这些害虫的尸体里寻找。
descriptions.en: Order an orbital bombardment of the swarm. If there are any secrets worth discovering, we will harvest them from the shells of these gnats.

descriptions.zh: 我们对人工智能的进阶科技可以用于重编程并驯服这些纳米机器人。他们可以在这个行星上建造建筑时贡献巨大的力量，而他们与这颗星球的生态系统之间的关联，则可能可以利用来创造一个天堂。
descriptions.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should be possible to instruct the nanites to create a paradise.

descriptions.zh: 我们对人工智能的进阶科技可以用于重编程并驯服这些纳米机器人。他们可以在这个行星上建造建筑时贡献巨大的力量，而他们与这颗星球的生态系统之间的关联，则可能可以利用来创造我们的第二母星。
descriptions.en: Our advanced knowledge of Artificial Intelligence can be used to reprogram and tame the nanites. They could be a great asset in building structures on the planet - and with their link to the world's ecosystem, it should be possible to instruct the nanites to create a second homeworld.

descriptions.zh:
我们物种的效能将会降低，但可育而且稳定到能进行基因修饰。

效果：
—['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile']特质替换为['trait:trait_clone_soldier_fertile']特质
—这一路径将§R拆除§!所有的['building:building_clone_army_clone_vat', 远古克隆仓]。
—现在可以选择['ascension_perk:ap_engineered_evolution']飞升天赋了。
descriptions.en:
Our species will become less efficient, but fertile and stable enough for genetic modification.

Effects:
- The ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_infertile'] trait is replaced with the ['trait:trait_clone_soldier_fertile'] trait.
- This path will result in all ['building:building_clone_army_clone_vat', Ancient Clone Vats] being §Rdisassembled§!.
- The ['ascension_perk:ap_engineered_evolution'] Ascension Perk can now be taken.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName] 上的一个异常现象揭示了一群奇特的真菌的存在，它发出了一个信号……大概是。通过在源头放大信号的方法，我们的科学家相信我们可以发现该信号的目的地并更多地了解这种菌丝体。
descriptions.en: An anomaly on [From.GetName] has revealed the existence of a colony of strange fungi sending a signal... Somewhere. By amplifying it at the source, our scientists believe we could discover the destination of that signal and understand more about this mycelium.

descriptions.zh: 突变孢子的发现，为我们开发菌丝体监听阵列提供了一个独特的机会。这些孢子更大，发出更强的信号，可以帮助我们促进“巨大蘑菇”的发育。
descriptions.en: The discovery of mutated spores offers a unique opportunity to develop our Mycelial Listening Array. These spores are bigger, send a stronger signal, and could help us foster the development of the 'Fumongus.'

descriptions.zh: 我们的科研船将大胆地发射探针，这一探针会将自身植入龙鳞之下，揭开龙那独特生命形态的奥秘。
descriptions.en: Our science vessel will boldly launch a probe that will implant itself underneath the dragon's scales and uncover the secrets of its unique biology.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科研船将在安全距离上对龙进行扫描，揣摩其独特生命形态的奥秘。
descriptions.en: Our science vessel will scan the dragon from a safe distance to divine the secrets of its unique biology.

descriptions.zh: 这些可以在极高辐射强度的星球下存活并繁衍兴盛的植物可以作为我们帝国绝佳的补充。不过在此之前，我们需要提升他们的心智并在数月内教会它们我们数千年来的进展。
descriptions.en: These plants that can live and thrive on worlds with more radiation than atmosphere could be an excellent addition to our empire. But before then, we will need to enhance their minds and teach them thousands of years of progress in a few months.

descriptions.zh: 为错误赎罪是一项强权者的特权，在此情此景下，我们必须深切地赎罪。[From.GetName]上的灾难令人震愕，而我们唯一的愿望是我们的科学家们能够反转我们深层探测器的极性，寄希望于能以此重新点燃这颗气态巨行星内部的生命之火。
descriptions.en: Atoning for your mistakes is a privilege for those with power, and in this scenario, we must atone dearly. The disaster on [From.GetName] was horrifying, and our only hope is that our scientists can reverse the polarity of our deep scanners and potentially reignite the spark of life inside the gas giant.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]被[FromFrom.GetName]上的风暴围困。他们唯一的希望在于我们发射一艘新飞船过去，然后远距离重调制他们的护盾频率。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] is trapped in a storm on [FromFrom.GetName]. Their only hope may rest in our sending a new ship there, and remotely modulating their shield frequencies.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗奇怪的小行星，它似乎可以通过未知的方式旋转并躲开我们的开采站。我们需要委派一艘科研船去研究它。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] is a strange asteroid that seems to be able to rotate and avoid our mining station through unknown means. We should dispatch a science ship to discover how.

descriptions.zh: 一具发现于[From.GetName]了无生机的地表上的巨型骸骨，其历史可追溯到三百万年前。我们的死灵法师已经跃跃欲试了。
descriptions.en: A gigantic skeleton dating back more than three billion years has been found on the lifeless surface of [From.GetName]. Our necromancers are to put their art to use.

descriptions.zh: 在[Solar_System.GetName]发现的这颗巨型的蛋刚刚开始产生裂缝。这是一次难以置信的好机会，能够近距离研究这种巨大生命体的繁育循环。
descriptions.en: The great egg we have discovered in [Solar_System.GetName] is just begging to be dissected. It's an incredible opportunity to get to study such a gargantuan creature's reproductive cycle this close.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一艘废弃的科研船，它在希洛士星系巡逻徘徊了一个世纪。这段孤旅背后蕴藏着怎样的隐情？
descriptions.en: An abandoned science vessel is caught in a centuries-long patrol of the Hillos system. What lies at the heart of this lonely odyssey?

descriptions.zh: 在希洛士星系检测到的灵能低语很显然属于被困在“幽灵船”乌布梅上的人工意识体。
descriptions.en: The psionic chatter detected in the Hillos system appears to belong to the artificial consciousness trapped aboard the 'ghost ship' Ubume.

descriptions.zh: 缇扬奇以气体为食。建造一座气体散播站，我们就能引走那些守在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系的缇扬奇，并且接近他们的坟场。
descriptions.en: Tiyanki feed on gas. By building a gas diffuser station, we may lure out the Tiyanki stationed in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system and gain access to their burial ground.

descriptions.zh:
通过将大量资源转移到离网操作上，我们希望能识别并销毁掉所有失控的人工智能系统，并使它们恢复正常。

这将耗费更多时间，但如果我们及时完成，希望后果不会有那么大的危害。
descriptions.en:
By diverting considerable resources to an off-the-grid operation, we hope to identify and neutralize any rampant AI systems and bring them back in line.

It will take more time, but the results will hopefully be less detrimental, if we manage to complete it in time.

descriptions.zh:
一种解决这些产生问题的人工智能迭代的最终方案是将我们的科学系统中所有神经模拟网络全部抹除，因为这是失控最突出的地方；并从头开始构建所有这些工具，在其中植入严谨的安全措施。

如果我们及时完成，这将使我们倒退20年。
descriptions.en:
One ultimate solution to the problematic AI recursion is to completely wipe all traces of neurosimulative networks within our scientific systems, where the problems are most rampant, and rebuild all these tools from scratch with scrupulous security measures.

This would set us back significantly for at least 20 years, if we can complete it in time.

descriptions.zh: 我们应当学习如何安全地将一个行星辐射化，不给当地人群造成过大的不便。
descriptions.en: We shall study how to safely irradiate a planet, without unduly inconveniencing the local population.

descriptions.zh: 在做好一切准备后，是时候让这些机器启动运行了，将它们连接到星球电网之中！
descriptions.en: Now, after all the preparations we've made, it's time for us to get all this machinery up and running, connect the facility to the planetary power grid!

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上的水晶发出的令人迷惑的信号引人好奇。建议进行进一步研究。
descriptions.en: The disorientating signals emanating from the crystal on [From.GetName] are a curiosity. Further study is advised.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的[Owner.GetColonistPluralCap]最近开始一个接一个地失踪。调查发现了一些独特的带电粒子残留。我们会利用所有已知的信息来寻找失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
descriptions.en: [Owner.GetColonistPluralCap] on [Root.GetName] have been disappearing. A break in the investigation indicated the presence of a uniquely charged particle residue. We will use all available information to locate the missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

descriptions.zh: 在一低层大气碰撞事故后，[Root.GetName]的轨道布满了太空碎片。如果不尽快清理，次生灾害可能导致这颗星球的交通中断。
descriptions.en: The orbit of [Root.GetName] is littered with space debris after a collision in the lower atmosphere. It must be cleared before a cascading effect renders the planet inaccessible.

descriptions.zh: 在一低层大气碰撞事故后，[Root.GetName]的轨道布满了太空碎片。必须不惜一切代价进行彻底的清理才能保证定居者未来的安全。
descriptions.en: The orbit of [Root.GetName] is littered with space debris after a collision in the lower atmosphere. It must be thoroughly cleaned to ensure a secure future for the inhabitants, regardless of the cost.

descriptions.zh: 对[myrmeku_planet.GetName]上的密弥库蚁进行研究，以厘清其残暴的行为是否能变害为宝。
descriptions.en: A study of the Myrmeku on [myrmeku_planet.GetName] to determine if their vigorous activity can be turned into something useful.

descriptions.zh: 研究§Y[planet.GetName]§!上平流层喷口的独特结构及其对太空兽群的重要性。
descriptions.en: Study the unique stratospheric vent formations on §Y[planet.GetName]§! and their significance to Space Fauna.

descriptions.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的温度迅速升高。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]需要扩大他们的研究范围，以解决正在进行的局势所造成的新问题。
descriptions.en: The temperature on [flooding_planet.GetName] has risen alarmingly quickly. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] need to expand the scope of their studies to address the new issues created by the ongoing situation.

descriptions.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]上的气候迅速恶化。希望我们可以赶在局面无法扭转之前弄清楚原因。
descriptions.en: The climate on [flooding_planet.GetName] is rapidly deteriorating. Hopefully we can figure out why before it is too late to reverse the process.

descriptions.zh: 一群迅速蔓延的哺乳动物在行星[desertling_planet.Planet.GetName]上过度繁殖。凭借适当的资源，我们的科学家可以收集更多关于这种非智慧物种的起源和能力的线索。
descriptions.en: The planet [desertling_planet.Planet.GetName] is overpopulated by a herd of rapidly spreading mammals. With the proper resources, our scientists could gather more insights about the origins and capabilities of this non-sapient species.

descriptions.zh: 为了拯救[desertling_planet.GetName]的生态状态，必须抑制入侵动物群的指数级数量增长。我们的科学家需要时间和资源来找到可行的解决方案。
descriptions.en: To save the ecological state of [desertling_planet.GetName] the exponential population growth of the invading fauna's population must be suppressed. Our scientists need time and resources to find an executable solution.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的地表偶然发现了一种怪异的岩石形态。需要进一步研究才能确定为何它会存在于这颗其他方面都贫瘠的星球上。
descriptions.en: We have stumbled upon a grotesque rock formation on the surface of [From.GetName]. Further study is needed to determine why it remains on this otherwise barren planet.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]的冰封地壳之下，存在一片广阔的地下洞穴。我们拟派遣一支考察队，对这一特殊环境展开进一步研究。
descriptions.en: There is a vast subterranean cavern underneath the icy crust of [From.GetName]. We would like to send an expedition to study this extraordinary environment further.

descriptions.zh: 坦佩里翁国王把永朽之暗的碎片托付给了我们。通过研究它的灵魂碎片，我们可能就能发现它的巢穴位置，找到打破它对阿纳萨里的控制的方法。
descriptions.en: King Tamperion has entrusted us with a fragment of the Dark Immortal. By studying its essence, we may uncover the location of its lair and the means to break its hold over the Anathari.

descriptions.zh: 坦佩里翁国王把永朽之暗的碎片托付给了我们。通过研究它的灵魂碎片，我们可能就能发现它的巢穴位置，找到打破它对阿纳萨里的控制的方法。
descriptions.en: King Tamperion has entrusted us with a fragment of the Dark Immortal. By studying its essence, we may uncover the location of its lair and the means to break its hold over the Anathari.
